snippet.description:
PMP 2027 Gets a Major Upgrade | GS + CSAT + Current Affairs

The Prelims Master Program (PMP) 2027 at LevelUp IAS has received a major upgrade. What was earlier primarily focused on GS classes has now evolved into a more comprehensive UPSC Prelims preparation programme, bringing GS, CSAT and Current Affairs together under one structured framework.

Whether you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or looking for a structured approach to Prelims preparation, PMP 2027 brings together the classes, study material, practice and assessments you need throughout your preparation.

What's included in PMP 2027?

- GS Preparation: Comprehensive subject-wise classes for UPSC Prelims.
- CSAT Preparation: Dedicated classes and practice for CSAT Paper 2.
- Current Affairs: Integrated current affairs coverage for Prelims.
- UPSC PYQ Analysis: Previous Year Questions discussed in classes.
- Comprehensive Notes: Structured study material for revision.
- Daily Practice Tests: Regular MCQ practice to strengthen concepts.
- Weekly Tests: Consistent assessment of your preparation.
- Open Mock Tests: Evaluate your performance in a competitive environment.
- Samiksha Tests: Compare your performance with thousands of UPSC aspirants across the country.

From conceptual clarity and current affairs to PYQ practice, CSAT, mock tests and performance assessment, PMP 2027 brings multiple aspects of UPSC Prelims preparation together in one programme.

snippet.description:
Is your daily 10-12 hour UPSC study routine quietly destroying your posture, draining your energy, and causing severe neck and back pain?

In this essential health and wellness workshop at LevelUp IAS, Sonali Ma'am (Counseling Psychologist) and Dr. Rachita Luthra (Musculoskeletal Physiotherapist with 12+ years of experience) tackle the hidden physical toll of UPSC preparation.

🎟 FREE MOVIE SCREENING AT LEVELUP IAS
🔗 Register HERE: https://tinyurl.com/4r9k6mpb

📅 15 November
🕠 5:30 PM onwards
📍 LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh

🛋️ Counselling Session with Sonali Ma'am
🔗 Register HERE: https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-cse-psychological-counselling/#book 

👉 Free 1:1 counseling for all UPSC Aspirants at LevelUp IAS

Because your well-being matters, on the way to your goal and beyond

📲Queries? Call directly- 8826496658

Meet us 📍 at LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/NvPyzytSwDQYE...
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐔𝐬 
👉 For regular updates from Sonali Ma'am, join the Telegram Channel: https://web.telegram.org/a/#-1001797988294 
👉 For regular current affairs updates from Santosh sir, join the Telegram Channel: https://t.me/Santoshkumarcurrentaffairs  
👉 For regular course updates, visit our Telegram Channel: https://t.me/levelupias  
👉 For important updates, visit our Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/levelupiasedutech/ 
https://www.instagram.com/currentaffairs_levelupias/

00:00 – Introduction: The Hidden Physical Toll of UPSC Prep
04:06 – The Dangers of Prolonged Sitting (Upper & Lower Cross Syndrome)
06:36 – Managing Pain, Stiffness & The 5-Minute Movement Rule
14:21 – Sleep Posture Correction & Quick Room Workouts
17:19 – Mains Answer Writing: Wrist Endurance, Ergonomic Pens & Arm Support
23:48 – Fixing Your Desk Setup & Correcting Common Posture Mistakes
28:21 – Live Demonstration: Planks, Squats & The 10-Step Desk Exercise Routine
40:37 – Maximizing Focus: Desk Decluttering & Exam Day Breathing
43:22 – Q&A Part 1: Eye Strain Relief, Workouts & Posture During Commutes
50:03 – Q&A Part 2: Winter Care, Pollution & Essential Vitamins (D3 & B12)
1:00:27 – Final Conclusion: Building the "Blinder" Mindset
